Letting go of pain and anger is never easy, but we must do this to forge an alliance ''today''. Tomorrow is tomorrow.|K'Kruhk|}} In [[137 ABY]], [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Roan Fel]] of the [[Empire-in-exile]] left the Imperial [[Fortress world/Legends|fortress world]] of [[Bastion/Legends|Bastion]] to '''meet''' with representatives of the [[New Jedi Order|Jedi Order]] on [[Agamar/Legends|Agamar]]. Both Fel's Empire and the Jedi were [[Second Imperial Civil War|fighting]] against [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]], and both groups had already allied with the [[Galactic Alliance Remnant]]. An agreement on Agamar would solidify the mutual cooperation of all three groups. The Jedi had been distrustful of Fel for the past seven [[Standard year/Legends|years]], believing him to be responsible for an [[Massacre at Ossus|attack]] on the Jedi that had scattered their order, and had only recently learned that the attack had in fact happened against his orders. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[K'Kruhk]] and three Jedi traveled to Agamar from their [[Hidden Temple (Sith–Imperial War)|Hidden Temple]] and met with Fel, who brought along a [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]] of over ten of his [[Imperial Knight]]s. They met in an open field, all dressed as [[Farm/Legends|farmers]], and were able to come to an agreement without incident. Immediately after terms were reached, [[Morrigan Corde|Nyna Calixte]], the [[Director of Imperial Intelligence]] for [[Darth Krayt]]'s Empire who was secretly aiding Fel, rushed onto the scene and informed everyone present that [[First Sith Imperial Strikeforce|agents]] of her Empire had learned of the meeting and were preparing to [[Operation: Thunderstroke|attack]]. Forces of the [[One Sith]] rose from some nearby swamps, and a battle began. ==Prelude== {{Quote|The Jedi have nothing to fear from my father. Roan Fel is not your enemy. He never truly was.|Marasiah Fel, to the [[Jedi High Council (New Jedi Order)|Jedi Council]]|[[Legacy (2006) 25|''Legacy'' (2006) 25]]}} Prior to [[127 ABY]], the [[New Jedi Order|Jedi Order]] and the [[Fel Empire]] were allies. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] were working closely with the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Species/Legends|species]] to [[Ossus Project|restore]] [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] that had been ravaged when the Yuuzhan Vong had [[Yuuzhan Vong War|invaded]] the galaxy [[25 ABY/Legends|100 years]] beforehand, but agents of the [[One Sith]] secretly sabotaged their efforts and framed the Yuuzhan Vong.[[Legacy (2006) 1|''Legacy'' (2006) 1]][[Star Wars: Legacy (2006) 0½|''Star Wars: Legacy'' (2006) 0½]] [[Roan Fel]], [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] of the Fel Empire, and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kol Skywalker]] attempted to discover who was responsible, but Fel's [[Council of Moffs/Legends|Council of Moffs]], who were, unbeknown to him, allied with the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], overruled his authority and called for war. A [[Sith–Imperial War|three-year war]] raged that pitted the Empire against the Jedi and the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]], and in [[130 ABY]], the Empire, aided by the Sith, became the victors. Fel ordered his Empire to allow the Jedi to remain on [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] unharmed, but the Sith acted against his orders and [[Massacre at Ossus|attacked]] the Jedi, [[Death/Legends|killing]] many and scattering the rest. The [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Krayt]] [[Attack on Emperor Fel|attempted]] to [[Assassin/Legends|assassinate]] Fel, but the Emperor fled into [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exile]]. Krayt now sat on the throne of a [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|new Empire]]. By [[137 ABY]], many Jedi had found their way to a [[Hidden Temple (Sith–Imperial War)|Hidden Temple]], and Fel had formed an [[Empire-in-exile]] situated on the [[Fortress world/Legends|fortress world]] of [[Bastion/Legends|Bastion]].[[Legacy (2006) 3|''Legacy'' (2006) 3]] The Jedi saw Fel as their enemy, believing that he had ordered their massacre at Ossus.[[Legacy (2006) 7|''Legacy'' (2006) 7]] The [[Galactic Alliance Remnant]] had been waging its own guerrilla war against Krayt's Empire, and both Fel and the Jedi formed alliances with the Remnant's [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gar Stazi]] against their common enemy.[[Legacy (2006) 36|''Legacy'' (2006) 36]] Three of Fel's [[Imperial Knight]]s, including his daughter [[Marasiah Fel|Marasiah]], infiltrated the Jedi's Hidden Temple on a mission of peace and told the Jedi the truth about Ossus. Marasiah remained at the temple for some [[Time/Legends|time]], attempting to negotiate an alliance between her father and the Jedi against Krayt.[[Legacy (2006) 26|''Legacy'' (2006) 26]] Eventually, Fel agreed to meet with the Jedi in person and negotiate with them at a neutral location, hoping to solidify a three-way alliance. ==The meeting== {{Quote|Then we are agreed, Master K'Kruhk?"''
''"On all major points, your Imperial Highness, yes—We will cooperate and coordinate our attacks together, working in concert. Bastion will give safe haven to Jedi, as will Admiral Stazi's forces.|Roan Fel and K'Kruhk|}} Fel traveled to [[Agamar/Legends|Agamar]] in the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Dauntless (Pellaeon-class)|''Dauntless'']], bringing with him over ten Imperial Knight [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguards]]. Master [[K'Kruhk]] led the Jedi contingent, bringing with him two other Masters and one [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]]. Both groups arrived onworld and made their own camp, waiting for morning to come, hopefully bringing with it the opportunity for a fresh start. Some of the Jedi were uncertain if they could trust Fel, and [[Antares Draco]], the leader of the Imperial Knights, was concerned about a possible security leak. Unknown to either of the parties, [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Rulf Yage]] of Krayt's Empire had learned about the meeting and was commanding a [[First Sith Imperial Strikeforce|Strike Force]] that intended to capture Fel. In the morning, all of the Jedi and Imperial Knights dressed as [[Agamarian]] [[Farm/Legends|farmers]] and met in an open field. Fel and K'Kruhk were able to come to a mutually beneficial agreement without incident, but their proceedings were soon after interrupted by [[Morrigan Corde|Nyna Calixte]]. Calixte was the [[Director of Imperial Intelligence]] for Krayt's Empire but was secretly aiding Fel. After two Imperial Knights began firing [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifles]] at the [[Agamarian beast|beast]] she was riding, the creature skidded into the field and Calixte collapsed onto the ground. She warned them of the impending attack, and as Yage's strike force began [[Operation: Thunderstroke|battling]] the ''Dauntless'' in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]], a group of Sith rose form some nearby swamps. A skirmish began.[[Legacy (2006) 46|''Legacy'' (2006) 46]] ==Aftermath== {{Quote|The Sith know about this meeting! Veed has sent a strike force to kill or capture the Emperor! They're here ''now''! You've got to ''run''!|Nyna Calixte|}} {{Main|Operation: Thunderstroke}} K'Kruhk and the Imperial Knight [[Treis Sinde]] called on their respective forces to protect the Emperor. The ensuing battle saw at least ten Sith fall to the [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] of the Jedi and Imperial Knights, as well as to Calixte's [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]]. Several Imperial Knights and Jedi fell as well,[[Legacy (2006) 48|''Legacy'' (2006) 48]] but most of the survivors, including Fel, were able evacuate the planet on the escape [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] ''[[Defender One]]''. The ''Dauntless'' was destroyed as ''Defender One'' fled into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]], and Marasiah was taken by the Sith. ==Behind the scenes== The peace talks between the Empire-in-exile and the Jedi were one of several major storylines in the [[2009]]-[[2010]] [[Star Wars: Legacy: Monster|''Monster'']] story arc of the [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] series ''[[Star Wars: Legacy]]''. ==Appearances== *[[Legacy (2006) 43|''Legacy'' (2006) 43]] {{1stm}} *[[Legacy (2006) 44|''Legacy'' (2006) 44]] {{1st}} *[[Legacy (2006) 45|''Legacy'' (2006) 45]] *[[Legacy (2006) 46|''Legacy'' (2006) 46]] *[[Legacy (2006) 47|''Legacy'' (2006) 47]] {{Imo}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{SecondImperialCivilWarNav}} {{Interlang |es=Misión a Agamar }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Agamar, mission to}} [[Category:Battles of Agamar]] [[Category:Missions of the Second Imperial Civil War]]
